instructions:
1. Lie on your right side with your legs straight and stacked, propped on your right elbow under your shoulder.
2. Lift your hips off the floor to form a straight line from head to feet. Raise your left arm toward the ceiling.
3. Lower your hips with control until they nearly touch the floor.
4. Drive your hips back up to the straight line position.
5. Finish one side, then switch to your left side. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your body in one straight line, do not let your hips sag forward or back.
2. Move the hips slowly and with control.
3. Exhale as you lift the hips, inhale as you lower.
4. Keep your elbow directly under your shoulder for support.

instructions:
1. Lie on your right side with your legs bent and stacked. Place your right arm across your chest and your left hand on the floor in front of you.
2. Press your left hand into the floor to push your upper body up.
3. Hold briefly at the top, feeling the triceps and chest contract.
4. Lower your upper body back down with control.
5. Finish one side, then switch to your left side. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you push up, inhale as you lower.
2. Plant the supporting hand firmly for stability.
3. Drive through the triceps, do not use momentum.
4. Keep your core braced to protect the spine.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, knees slightly bent. Hold your fists up in a guard position.
2. Rotate your torso left and punch across your body with your right hand, extending the arm fully.
3. Return to the guard position.
4. Rotate your torso right and punch across your body with your left hand.
5. Keep alternating sides at a steady pace. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive each punch from torso rotation, not just the arm.
2. Keep your legs and hips stable while the torso turns.
3. Exhale sharply on each punch, inhale as you reset.
4. Keep the non-punching fist up to guard.

instructions:
1. Start in a push-up position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, body in a straight line.
2. Lower your body while leaning toward the right, bringing your chest near your right hand.
3. Push through both hands back to the start.
4. Lower again while leaning toward the left, bringing your chest near your left hand.
5. Keep alternating sides each rep. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you push up, inhale as you lower.
2. Keep your body in one straight line, do not let the hips drop.
3. Plant both hands firmly for stability.
4. Brace your core to control the side-to-side shift.

instructions:
1. Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Extend your right arm across your torso at chest height, keeping the forearm parallel to the floor.
3. Grasp your right hand with your left hand and gently pull the wrist backward.
4. Hold the stretch and feel it in the right wrist and forearm.
5. Release slowly, then switch sides. Repeat.
tips:
1. Pull slowly, never jerk the wrist.
2. Breathe deeply and steadily through the hold.
3. Relax into the stretch to let the forearm lengthen.
4. Stop if you feel sharp pain in the joint.
